{{Top|leg}}
'''Stun toxin''' was a form of [[Poison/Legends|poison]] that could incapacitate an individual. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jodo Kast]] was known to coat [[Rocket dart/Legends|rocket darts]] in stun toxin when hunting [[Bounty/Legends|bounties]].<ref name="TM-CA3">{{WEGCite|book=Classic Adventures: Volume Three|story=Tatooine Manhunt}}</ref>
